subject.why: The candlestick telephone is instantly recognizable with its round base, tall stem, mouthpiece, and detached hopping earpiece on a curly cord.

category.why: The telephone floats freely in space with no floor or table, tilted in three-quarter view, against a saturated radiating sunburst background.

clean.why: No text, UI, logos, borders, or characters are present.

framing.why: The telephone is nicely centered with ample margins on all sides and a bold, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: The warm pink background is vibrant and saturated, providing excellent contrast against the black and gold telephone.

detail.why: The shapes are clean, bold, and simplified without distracting micro-textures or extraneous details.

style.why: Matches the reference style perfectly with smooth chunky 3D forms, soft satin/gloss lighting, and no outlines.

bg_colour.why: background is red (56% of the background); planned pink
